name: sourcedrecall
description: Local memory for Claude Code that keeps the record: what you said, in your own words with dates, and what each coding session did (commands, failures, fixes, decisions), searchable with /recall. Runs beside Claude Code's own memory. No language model writes the memory, and it stays on your machine.

owner.title: Your name
owner.description: The person this memory is about. Facts are written about this name.

briefing.title: Summary at session start
briefing.description: Give Claude a short summary of what it knows about you at the start of each session. Turn off to use memory only when you or Claude ask for it.

notes.title: Notes (off, small or standard)
notes.description: Optional: a small model, run on your machine with no server, writes short notes of what you said once per session (small: 0.5 GB download; standard: 1.4 GB). Off by default: memory then uses no language model at all.
